messages.subject: WC-00146 - Saxena settlement EXECUTED
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert, Grace,

The settlement agreement has been executed by both parties and Ms Marsh has signed the adviser's certificate. The executed copy is attached for your records. Headline terms: ex gratia £130,000, PILON £71,000, fee contribution £750+VAT, outplacement £4,000+VAT, agreed reference; her right to make protected disclosures and to contact the CAA is expressly preserved. Accounts will arrange the payments within 28 days. This concludes the employment matter.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0211
